meta.title: 分享几个超简单的拍照姿势
meta.title_en: Share a Few Super-Easy Photo Poses
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 简单姿势

scenes.title_en: By the Tree: Lean and Bend One Knee
scenes.context: 不是这样站在树边，是稍微往旁边站一步，肩膀靠在树上，右腿弯曲。树边站姿：靠树+屈一条腿。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: Don't just stand stiffly by the tree.
是稍微往旁边站一步，肩膀靠在树上。
Step aside a little and lean your shoulder on the tree.
Bend the right knee for a more relaxed pose.
paraphrase: 靠树 → lean on the tree / rest against the tree
scenes.speak: Don't just stand stiffly by the tree. Step aside a little and lean your shoulder on the tree. Bend the right knee for a more relaxed pose.

scenes.title_en: Back View: Hair Over and Look Back
scenes.context: 不是这样拍背影，是把头发撩到前面来，一只手插腰，回头抓拍。背影照：撩头发+插腰+回头。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: Don't shoot the back view like that.
把头发撩到前面来，一只手插腰。
Sweep your hair forward and put one hand on your waist.
回头抓拍，自然又有氛围。
Turn back for a candid shot — natural and atmospheric.
paraphrase: 撩头发 → sweep the hair / brush hair forward
回头抓拍 → turn back for a candid / glance-back shot
scenes.speak: Don't shoot the back view like that. Sweep your hair forward and put one hand on your waist. Turn back for a candid shot — natural and atmospheric.

scenes.title_en: Seated: Side-On With a Supporting Hand
scenes.context: 不是这样坐在椅子上，是侧过来，一只手撑住身体，下面这条腿伸直，上面的腿微曲，整个人放在画面对角线上。坐姿：侧身+撑手+腿一伸一屈。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: 不是这样坐在椅子上，是侧过来。
Don't sit like that — turn to the side.
一只手撑住身体，下面这条腿伸直。
Support yourself with one hand and straighten the lower leg.
上面的腿微曲，整个人放在对角线上。
Bend the top knee slightly and place yourself on the diagonal.
paraphrase: 撑住身体 → support yourself / prop up the body
一伸一屈 → one straight, one bent / straight and bent legs
scenes.speak: Don't sit like that — turn to the side. Support yourself with one hand and straighten the lower leg. Bend the top knee slightly and place yourself on the diagonal.

scenes.title_en: Squat: Keep the Upper Body Straight
scenes.context: 不是这样蹲着拍照，是上身挺直，双腿并拢往下放。蹲姿：上身挺直+双腿并拢。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: Don't shoot while squatting like that.
Bring your legs together and lower them.
paraphrase: 上身挺直 → upper body straight / keep the torso upright
双腿并拢 → legs together / knees together
scenes.speak: Don't shoot while squatting like that. Keep your upper body straight. Bring your legs together and lower them.

practice: Step aside, lean your shoulder on the tree, and bend the right knee.
Sweep your hair forward, hand on the waist, and turn back for a candid.
Turn to the side, support with one hand, and place yourself on the diagonal.
Keep your upper body straight with your legs together.
pitfalls: Lean your shoulder on the tree.
「肩膀靠树」用 lean your shoulder on the tree。
Put the hair to the front.
「撩头发到前面」用 sweep your hair forward。
「一只手撑住身体」用 support yourself with one hand。
Keep your upper body straight and bring your legs together.
「蹲姿」关键点：上身挺直（upper body straight）。
shifts: 用 lean your shoulder（靠树）、sweep your hair（撩头发）、support with one hand（撑手）
用 bend the knee（屈膝）、straighten the lower leg（伸直）、legs together（并拢）
用 candid shot（抓拍）、atmospheric（有氛围）、relaxed pose（松弛）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：刮面→画面、上腿微曲、下腿伸直、撑住身体、双腿并拢、上身挺直、肩膀靠树、撩头发、回头抓拍、插腰等。
